scope: Synthetic documentation example; not a finding about a real project.
coverage: Demonstrates the report format only. No application test was executed for this example.

findings.title: A failed write is displayed as saved
findings.trigger: A hypothetical storage write returns an error.
findings.cause: In this synthetic example, the caller discards the Result and always returns a success message.
findings.impact: The user may think an unsuccessful save completed.
findings.correction: Propagate or handle the write error before displaying success.
findings.prevention: Add a test where storage returns an error and assert that success is not displayed.
